3707755318.name: Emergency Re-entry
3707755318.description: Adds 1 stored Emergency Re-entry credit. After dying during an active run, use it to rejoin once that round.

3713829859.name: Zyntra Expedition Pack
3713829859.description: One repeatable supply pack: 1 stored Emergency Re-entry credit, 1 Entity Shield charge, and 3 Route Markers. These are consumables, not a permanent pass. Use re-entry after dying in an active round; activate the shield and place markers from your equipment HUD.
